svg.text: Protocols and ports are code defaults (2026-08)
independent of NAMRBD · shares only SBS & metadata stores
TxnKV gRPC (PD :2379) — membership · placement · EC metadata
* Ports are code defaults; docs and lab environments use overrides (e.g. namrbd-gateway 9899/9898, sbs-data 9460, NAMROS lab gateways 19090-19093, etcd 12379).
* Internal gRPC paths are plaintext (insecure) by default; TLS is optional on some gateway/TiKV paths only.
